name: brivya
description: Infrastructure for the Agentic Business Web.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @brivya/core && npm run build -w @brivya/manifest && npm run build -w @brivya/policy && npm run build -w @brivya/runtime && npm run build -w @brivya/adapter-rest && npm run build -w @brivya/adapter-mcp && npm run build -w @brivya/sdk && npm run build -w @brivya/cli
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @brivya/core && npm run typecheck -w @brivya/manifest && npm run typecheck -w @brivya/policy && npm run typecheck -w @brivya/runtime && npm run typecheck -w @brivya/adapter-rest && npm run typecheck -w @brivya/adapter-mcp && npm run typecheck -w @brivya/sdk && npm run typecheck -w @brivya/cli
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test packages/core/dist/test/*.test.js packages/manifest/dist/test/*.test.js packages/policy/dist/test/*.test.js packages/runtime/dist/test/*.test.js adapters/rest/dist/test/*.test.js adapters/mcp/dist/test/*.test.js packages/sdk/dist/test/*.test.js packages/cli/dist/test/*.test.js
